rule: Track candidate and active-bank context distribution and prevent work, business, team, or project scenarios from dominating personality measurement. Include meaningful ordinary-life coverage without imposing rigid equal quotas.
review_tests: Record context metadata for every candidate.
Report candidate and active-bank context distributions before proposing a new cohort.
Identify overrepresented work, business, team, and project contexts.
Use future cohorts to address meaningful context gaps rather than satisfy rigid quotas.
